name: smwmusic-crash-bash-papu-pummel-tie-breaker
title: Crash Bash - Papu Pummel / Tie Breaker
description:
An intense tribal song that plays in the boss fight against Papu Papu in Crash Bash. It also plays in the secret Tie Breaker minigame that is only avaliable in co-op mode when the two players are in different teams.

Note: Not compatible with Yoshi, thunder and Bonus End.
